# Rhythm Bubbles development notes

- This is a server-friendly H5 rewrite built with Phaser 3.90, TypeScript 5.9 and Vite 7.
- Run `npm run dev` for local work and `npm run build` before delivery.
- Gameplay rules live in `src/game/core/`; keep them deterministic and test them with `npm run test:logic`.
- Presentation lives in `src/game/BubbleScene.ts` and `src/ui/AppUI.ts`; preserve the mobile-first portrait layout and touch-safe targets.
- Generated artwork is under `public/art/`; procedural original audio is generated by `scripts/generate-audio.mjs` into `public/audio/`.
- Every meaningful gameplay change must be exercised through `scripts/e2e-production.mjs`, including screenshots and `window.render_game_to_text()`.
- Do not reintroduce Cocos Creator files or require a desktop game editor; all development and deployment must remain terminal-friendly.
